description: alembic upgrade head on an empty SQLite DB creates all 10 Sprint 1 tables with the versioned-policy column set
steps: Create empty SQLite file; cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head
Inspect schema: tables users, customers, asset_classes, risk_policy_versions, template_versions, goals, risk_assessments, recommendations, recommendation_allocations, audit_events exist
Assert risk_policy_versions and template_versions each have columns id, version_no (unique), status, definition, created_by, created_at, published_by, published_at
Run poetry run pytest ../tests/integration/repositories/test_schema_migration.py; assert pass

description: Only one DRAFT row per version table is allowed (partial unique index)
steps: On a migrated DB insert one DRAFT risk_policy_versions row; assert success
Insert a second DRAFT risk_policy_versions row; assert sqlalchemy IntegrityError
Repeat for template_versions; assert the same outcome

description: ORM update or delete of a PUBLISHED risk policy or template version raises PublishedVersionMutation and rolls back
steps: Run poetry run pytest ../tests/architecture/test_published_templates_immutable.py ../tests/integration/repositories/test_version_guards.py
Assert updating definition on a PUBLISHED TemplateVersion and RiskPolicyVersion raises PublishedVersionMutation, and after rollback the definition JSON is byte-identical
Assert ORM delete on a PUBLISHED row raises PublishedVersionMutation

description: DRAFT versions can be edited, deleted and transitioned to PUBLISHED
steps: Insert a DRAFT TemplateVersion; update its definition and flush; assert no error
Set status=PUBLISHED and flush; assert no error
Insert another DRAFT and delete it; assert the row is gone

description: UPDATE or DELETE on any of the four append-only tables raises AppendOnlyViolation
steps: Run poetry run pytest ../tests/architecture/test_append_only_tables.py
Assert for risk_assessments, recommendations, recommendation_allocations and audit_events: ORM update raises AppendOnlyViolation and ORM delete raises AppendOnlyViolation
Assert the repositories for these tables expose no update/delete method

description: Percentages and amounts are stored as DecimalText with no Float or Numeric columns
steps: Run poetry run pytest ../tests/architecture/test_no_float_money.py; assert pass
Assert recommendation_allocations.target_pct and goals.target_amount use DecimalText(scale=2)
Round-trip Decimal('7.50') through target_pct; assert the read value equals Decimal('7.50') and the stored SQLite value is TEXT '7.50'

description: No mutable band column exists and migration files are hash-locked
steps: Run poetry run pytest ../tests/architecture/test_band_reassignment_requires_override.py; assert no table other than risk_assessments and recommendations has a band column
Run poetry run pytest ../tests/architecture/test_migrations_locked.py; assert pass
Assert backend/migrations/LOCKED_HASHES.txt exists with lines formatted '<sha256>  <filename>'

description: Template validator reports AGGRESSIVE sum=100.01 and accepts the v1 template and the AC-10.5 v2 variant
steps: Call validate_template_version(TEMPLATE_AGGRESSIVE_100_01, {EQUITY, DEBT, GOLD, CASH})
Assert one violation string contains 'AGGRESSIVE' and 'sum=100.01'
Assert validate_template_version(TEMPLATE_V1, ...) == [] and validate_template_version(TEMPLATE_V2_AC_10_5, ...) == []

description: Template validator flags every structural rule violation from admin_versioning §2.3
steps: Run poetry run pytest ../tests/unit/domain/test_template_version_validator.py

Assert a named violation for: missing band; missing asset class; inactive/extra asset class; '10.005'; '100.01' single value; '-1.00'; H_60_83.min_months=61 gap; overlapping rules; shift 'HALF'; from == to; drift_threshold_pct '0.00'; drift_threshold_pct '50.01'; JSON number 50 instead of '50.00'

description: Risk policy validator accepts v1 and the AC-10.1 v2 bands (MODERATE 12-19, AGGRESSIVE 20-28)
steps: Call validate_risk_policy(RISK_POLICY_V1); assert []
Call validate_risk_policy(RISK_POLICY_V2_AC_10_1); assert []

description: Risk policy validator flags question, option, band and cap violations
steps: Run poetry run pytest ../tests/unit/domain/test_template_version_validator.py -k risk_policy

Assert a violation for: 5 questions; duplicate question code; orders 1,2,4,...; question with 1 option; question with 7 options; points 11; points -1; MODERATE 13-20 gap; last max_score 27 (max achievable 28); bands out of order; cap with unknown question; cap with unknown option; cap with unknown band

description: RiskBand ordering and min_band behave per spec
steps: Assert list(RiskBand) values == ['CONSERVATIVE','MODERATE','AGGRESSIVE']
Assert CONSERVATIVE < MODERATE < AGGRESSIVE
Assert min_band(RiskBand.AGGRESSIVE, RiskBand.MODERATE) == RiskBand.MODERATE

description: Domain validator and band modules are stdlib-only with 100% branch coverage
steps: Run poetry run pytest ../tests/architecture/test_domain_has_no_framework_imports.py ../tests/architecture/test_layering.py; assert pass
Run poetry run pytest ../tests/unit/domain --cov=app.domain --cov-branch; assert bands.py and template_version_validator.py report 100%

description: Seed migration inserts the four asset classes and exactly one PUBLISHED v1 risk policy and v1 template
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head
Assert asset_classes = EQUITY(1), DEBT(2), GOLD(3), CASH(4), all is_active true
Assert risk_policy_versions has 1 row: version_no 1, status PUBLISHED, 7 questions, bands 0-11/12-20/21-28, cap NO_EMERGENCY_FUND

Assert template_versions has 1 row: version_no 1, status PUBLISHED, definition equals admin_versioning §2.3 JSON (MODERATE {EQUITY:'50.00',DEBT:'35.00',GOLD:'10.00',CASH:'5.00'}, drift_threshold_pct '5.00')

description: Every PUBLISHED template band in the migrated DB sums to exactly 100.00 and seeded definitions pass the validators
steps: Run poetry run pytest ../tests/architecture/test_allocation_sum_invariant.py ../tests/integration/repositories/test_seed_migration.py
Assert each band of each PUBLISHED template_versions row sums to Decimal('100.00')
Assert validate_risk_policy and validate_template_version return [] for the seeded v1 definitions

description: Seed creates 7 synthetic users, 5 customers (carol kyc false) and no assessments or recommendations
steps: Fresh DB: alembic upgrade head
Assert users: alice.customer, bob.customer, carol.customer, frank.customer, grace.customer (CUSTOMER), dan.advisor (ADVISOR), erin.admin (ADMIN)
Assert 5 customers rows; carol kyc_verified = false; others true
Assert risk_assessments, recommendations and audit_events are empty

description: Seed creates exactly three goals with fixed IDs for frank and grace
steps: Fresh DB: alembic upgrade head
Assert alice, bob and carol have 0 goals

description: Stub tokens for frank and grace authenticate as CUSTOMER and resolve to their own customer record
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
GET /api/v1/auth/whoami (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-frank); assert 200 {"username":"frank.customer","role":"CUSTOMER"}
GET /api/v1/auth/whoami (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-grace); assert 200 role CUSTOMER
Run poetry run pytest ../tests/integration/services/test_customer_resolver.py; assert each customer username maps to its seeded customer_id and ADVISOR/ADMIN principals raise

description: WEALTHWISE_FIXED_CLOCK pins the app clock; domain and services never call the wall clock
steps: Run poetry run pytest ../tests/integration/api/test_clock_injection.py; assert app.state.clock.today() == date(2026,1,15) with WEALTHWISE_FIXED_CLOCK=2026-01-15T09:00:00Z and is SystemClock without it
Run poetry run pytest ../tests/architecture/test_no_wall_clock.py; assert no date.today()/datetime.now() under backend/app/domain or backend/app/services

description: assess(v1, ANS_16) returns total 16, MODERATE/MODERATE, no caps
steps: Call assess(RISK_POLICY_V1, ANS_16)
Assert total_score == 16, computed_band == MODERATE, assigned_band == MODERATE, applied_caps == []

description: Band boundaries 0/11/12/20/21/28 map to C, C, M, M, A, A
steps: Call assess(RISK_POLICY_V1, s) for ANS_0, ANS_11, ANS_12, ANS_20, ANS_21, ANS_28
Assert total_score values 0, 11, 12, 20, 21, 28
Assert assigned_band values CONSERVATIVE, CONSERVATIVE, MODERATE, MODERATE, AGGRESSIVE, AGGRESSIVE (ANS_0 and ANS_11 have EMERGENCY_FUND=NONE)

description: NO_EMERGENCY_FUND cap lowers computed AGGRESSIVE (24) to MODERATE
steps: Call assess(RISK_POLICY_V1, ANS_CAP24)
Assert total_score == 24, computed_band == AGGRESSIVE, assigned_band == MODERATE, applied_caps == ['NO_EMERGENCY_FUND']

description: Scoring is deterministic across 100 runs and independent of answer order
steps: Call assess(RISK_POLICY_V1, ANS_16) 100 times; assert all results are equal
Call assess with ANS_16 reversed; assert the result equals the original

description: Invalid answer sets raise ANSWER_MISSING, OPTION_INVALID, ANSWER_DUPLICATE and QUESTION_UNKNOWN
steps: ANS_16 without OBJECTIVE -> assert AssessmentValidationError code ANSWER_MISSING
ANS_16 with AGE=GT_10Y -> assert code OPTION_INVALID
ANS_16 plus a second AGE answer -> assert code ANSWER_DUPLICATE
ANS_16 plus question SALARY -> assert code QUESTION_UNKNOWN

description: effective_band returns None with no events and the newest assessment otherwise, tie-broken by id
steps: Assert effective_band([], []) is None
Two assessments at 2026-01-15T09:00Z (MODERATE) and 2026-01-15T10:00Z (AGGRESSIVE); assert AGGRESSIVE
Two assessments with equal created_at; assert the one with the greater id wins

description: Policy is a parameter: ANS_20 is MODERATE under v1 and AGGRESSIVE under the AC-10.1 v2 policy
steps: Assert assess(RISK_POLICY_V1, ANS_20).assigned_band == MODERATE
Assert assess(RISK_POLICY_V2_AC_10_1, ANS_20).assigned_band == AGGRESSIVE
Run coverage on app.domain.risk_band_rules; assert 100% branch

description: horizon_months counts completed calendar months and clamps past dates to 0
steps: Assert horizon_months(2026-01-31, 2026-02-28) == 0
Assert horizon_months(2026-01-31, 2027-01-31) == 12

description: Horizon rule boundaries select the right v1 rule code
steps: For months 60, 83 assert H_60_83; 84, 240 -> H_84_PLUS
For months None assert NO_GOAL

description: recommend reproduces all five recommendation §2.3 worked examples exactly
steps: MODERATE/120 -> EQUITY 50.00, DEBT 35.00, GOLD 10.00, CASH 5.00 (H_84_PLUS)

description: recommend with no goal returns the §2.1 template row for each band
steps: recommend(CONSERVATIVE, TEMPLATE_V1, None) -> 20.00/60.00/10.00/10.00, rule NO_GOAL
recommend(MODERATE, TEMPLATE_V1, None) -> 50.00/35.00/10.00/5.00
recommend(AGGRESSIVE, TEMPLATE_V1, None) -> 75.00/15.00/7.50/2.50

description: Every band x horizon in {0,1,11,12,35,36,59,60,83,84,240} sums to exactly 100.00 with no negatives
steps: Loop over 3 bands x 11 horizons calling recommend(band, TEMPLATE_V1, months)
Assert each allocation has exactly EQUITY, DEBT, GOLD, CASH, each value >= Decimal('0.00') with exponent -2
Assert sum == Decimal('100.00') for all 33 cases

description: A corrupted MODERATE row summing to 99.99 raises AllocationSumError
steps: Build template with MODERATE {EQUITY:'50.00',DEBT:'34.99',GOLD:'10.00',CASH:'5.00'}
Call recommend(MODERATE, template, None); assert AllocationSumError

description: primary_goal picks lowest priority, then earliest target_date, then earliest created_at
steps: primary_goal([A(priority 2, 2040-01-01), B(priority 1, 2028-06-30)]) -> B
Equal priority: earlier target_date wins; equal priority and date: earlier created_at wins
primary_goal([]) -> None

description: recommend is deterministic and both modules have 100% branch coverage
steps: Call recommend(MODERATE, TEMPLATE_V1, 48) twice; assert equal Allocation objects
Run coverage on app.domain.goal_horizon_policy and app.domain.allocation_template_policy; assert 100% branch

description: Admin creates a risk-policy draft copied from v1 as version 2
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
POST /api/v1/admin/risk-policies/drafts (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-erin)
Assert 201, version_no == 2, status == 'DRAFT', definition equals GET /api/v1/admin/risk-policies/{v1_id} definition

description: Admin edits the draft bands to MODERATE 12-19 / AGGRESSIVE 20-28 and publishes v2; v1 remains PUBLISHED and unchanged
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
Record GET /api/v1/admin/risk-policies/{v1_id} body (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-erin); POST .../drafts -> v2_id
PUT /api/v1/admin/risk-policies/{v2_id} with definition whose bands are CONSERVATIVE 0-11, MODERATE 12-19, AGGRESSIVE 20-28; assert 200
POST /api/v1/admin/risk-policies/{v2_id}/publish; assert 200 {"version_no": 2, "status": "PUBLISHED"}
GET /api/v1/admin/risk-policies; assert two items both status PUBLISHED; GET v1 definition byte-identical to recorded body

description: Draft, update and publish each write an audit event without PII
steps: After the publish flow, query audit_events
Assert actions POLICY_DRAFT_CREATED, POLICY_DRAFT_UPDATED, POLICY_PUBLISHED with actor_role ADMIN
Assert details contain only ids/version numbers (no usernames, names or percentages)

description: PUT and DELETE on PUBLISHED template v1 return 409 POLICY_VERSION_IMMUTABLE and leave it byte-identical
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
GET /api/v1/admin/template-versions (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-erin); take v1_id; GET /api/v1/admin/template-versions/{v1_id} and record body
PUT /api/v1/admin/template-versions/{v1_id} with a modified definition; assert 409 error.code POLICY_VERSION_IMMUTABLE
DELETE /api/v1/admin/template-versions/{v1_id}; assert 409 POLICY_VERSION_IMMUTABLE
GET /api/v1/admin/template-versions/{v1_id}; assert definition byte-identical to recorded body

description: Publishing an already PUBLISHED version returns 409 ALREADY_PUBLISHED for both policy types
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
POST /api/v1/admin/template-versions/{v1_id}/publish (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-erin); assert 409 ALREADY_PUBLISHED
POST /api/v1/admin/risk-policies/{v1_id}/publish; assert 409 ALREADY_PUBLISHED; PUT risk-policies/{v1_id} -> 409 POLICY_VERSION_IMMUTABLE

description: Publishing a template draft whose AGGRESSIVE row sums to 100.01 returns 422 TEMPLATE_INVALID naming AGGRESSIVE and sum=100.01
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
POST /api/v1/admin/template-versions/drafts (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-erin) -> draft_id
PUT /api/v1/admin/template-versions/{draft_id} with v1 definition but AGGRESSIVE GOLD "7.51"; assert 200
POST /api/v1/admin/template-versions/{draft_id}/publish; assert 422 error.code TEMPLATE_INVALID and some error.details.violations[] item contains 'AGGRESSIVE' and 'sum=100.01'
GET /api/v1/admin/template-versions/{draft_id}; assert status DRAFT; list shows only v1 PUBLISHED

description: Invalid risk-policy draft publish returns 422 POLICY_INVALID; numeric percentages are rejected with 422 DECIMAL_MUST_BE_STRING
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
Create risk-policy draft (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-erin); PUT definition with only 5 questions; POST publish; assert 422 POLICY_INVALID
Create template draft; PUT definition with MODERATE EQUITY as JSON number 50 (not "50.00"); assert 422 DECIMAL_MUST_BE_STRING

description: A second draft request returns 409 DRAFT_EXISTS; deleting the draft allows a new one
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
POST /api/v1/admin/risk-policies/drafts (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-erin); assert 201
POST /api/v1/admin/risk-policies/drafts again; assert 409 error.code DRAFT_EXISTS
Repeat both calls on /api/v1/admin/template-versions/drafts; assert 201 then 409 DRAFT_EXISTS
DELETE /api/v1/admin/risk-policies/{draft_id}; assert 204; POST .../drafts; assert 201

description: CUSTOMER and ADVISOR tokens get 403 FORBIDDEN_ROLE on every admin route
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
For each route GET/POST drafts/GET {id}/PUT {id}/DELETE {id}/POST {id}/publish under /api/v1/admin/risk-policies and /api/v1/admin/template-versions:
call with header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice; assert 403 error.code FORBIDDEN_ROLE
call with header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-dan; assert 403 FORBIDDEN_ROLE

description: Admin routes without a token return 401 and every non-public route declares require_role
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
GET /api/v1/admin/risk-policies with no Authorization header; assert 401 error.code UNAUTHENTICATED
Run poetry run pytest ../tests/architecture/test_routes_declare_roles.py; assert pass

description: Questionnaire returns v1 with 7 ordered questions of 5 options and no points or thresholds
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
GET /api/v1/risk-profile/questionnaire (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice)
Assert 200, version_no == 1, policy_version_id present, question codes in order AGE, HORIZON, INCOME_STABILITY, EMERGENCY_FUND, LOSS_REACTION, EXPERIENCE, OBJECTIVE with order 1..7
Assert each question has 5 options; assert serialized body contains none of the keys points, bands, min_score, max_score, caps

description: Risk-profile routes reject non-customers and unauthenticated calls
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
GET /api/v1/risk-profile/questionnaire (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-dan); assert 403 FORBIDDEN_ROLE
POST /api/v1/risk-profile/assessments (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-erin); assert 403 FORBIDDEN_ROLE
GET /api/v1/risk-profile with no token; assert 401 UNAUTHENTICATED

description: Submitting the AC-01.2 answers returns 201 with total_score 16 and MODERATE
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true

GET /api/v1/risk-profile/questionnaire (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice); POST /api/v1/risk-profile/assessments (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice) body {"policy_version_id": <questionnaire.policy_version_id>, "answers": [{"question_code":"AGE","option_code":"AGE_30_39"},{"question_code":"HORIZON","option_code":"Y7_10"},{"question_code":"INCOME_STABILITY","option_code":"STABLE_SINGLE"},{"question_code":"EMERGENCY_FUND","option_code":"M3_6"},{"question_code":"LOSS_REACTION","option_code":"HOLD"},{"question_code":"EXPERIENCE","option_code":"FUNDS_LT_3Y"},{"question_code":"OBJECTIVE","option_code":"BALANCED"}]}; assert 201
Assert body total_score == 16, computed_band == 'MODERATE', assigned_band == 'MODERATE', applied_caps == [], policy_version_no == 1, assessment_id and created_at present

description: Submitting ANS_CAP24 returns computed AGGRESSIVE capped to MODERATE
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true

GET /api/v1/risk-profile/questionnaire (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice); POST /api/v1/risk-profile/assessments (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice) with policy_version_id from the questionnaire and answer set ANS_CAP24 (specs/stories/E2-S1.md); assert 201
Assert total_score == 24, computed_band == 'AGGRESSIVE', assigned_band == 'MODERATE', applied_caps == ['NO_EMERGENCY_FUND']

description: Each assessment writes exactly one risk_assessments row and one RISK_ASSESSMENT_SUBMITTED audit row
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true

GET /api/v1/risk-profile/questionnaire (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice); POST /api/v1/risk-profile/assessments (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice) body {"policy_version_id": <questionnaire.policy_version_id>, "answers": [{"question_code":"AGE","option_code":"AGE_30_39"},{"question_code":"HORIZON","option_code":"Y7_10"},{"question_code":"INCOME_STABILITY","option_code":"STABLE_SINGLE"},{"question_code":"EMERGENCY_FUND","option_code":"M3_6"},{"question_code":"LOSS_REACTION","option_code":"HOLD"},{"question_code":"EXPERIENCE","option_code":"FUNDS_LT_3Y"},{"question_code":"OBJECTIVE","option_code":"BALANCED"}]}; assert 201
Query DB: risk_assessments count == 1 for alice with risk_policy_version_id == v1 id; audit_events count == 1 with action RISK_ASSESSMENT_SUBMITTED, entity_id == assessment_id

description: Submitting the same answers twice gives identical scores and two distinct rows
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true

GET /api/v1/risk-profile/questionnaire (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice); POST /api/v1/risk-profile/assessments (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice) body {"policy_version_id": <questionnaire.policy_version_id>, "answers": [{"question_code":"AGE","option_code":"AGE_30_39"},{"question_code":"HORIZON","option_code":"Y7_10"},{"question_code":"INCOME_STABILITY","option_code":"STABLE_SINGLE"},{"question_code":"EMERGENCY_FUND","option_code":"M3_6"},{"question_code":"LOSS_REACTION","option_code":"HOLD"},{"question_code":"EXPERIENCE","option_code":"FUNDS_LT_3Y"},{"question_code":"OBJECTIVE","option_code":"BALANCED"}]}; assert 201 (twice)
Assert both responses have total_score 16, computed_band MODERATE, assigned_band MODERATE
Assert assessment_ids differ and risk_assessments has 2 rows for alice

description: Missing OBJECTIVE returns 422 ANSWER_MISSING and AGE=GT_10Y returns 422 OPTION_INVALID with no rows written
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
POST /api/v1/risk-profile/assessments (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice) with ANS_16 minus OBJECTIVE; assert 422 error.code ANSWER_MISSING
POST with ANS_16 but AGE option GT_10Y; assert 422 error.code OPTION_INVALID
Assert risk_assessments and audit_events counts are 0

description: Effective band is null before assessment and follows the newest assessment; history is newest first
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
GET /api/v1/risk-profile (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice); assert 200 {"risk_band": null}

GET /api/v1/risk-profile/questionnaire (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice); POST /api/v1/risk-profile/assessments (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice) body {"policy_version_id": <questionnaire.policy_version_id>, "answers": [{"question_code":"AGE","option_code":"AGE_30_39"},{"question_code":"HORIZON","option_code":"Y7_10"},{"question_code":"INCOME_STABILITY","option_code":"STABLE_SINGLE"},{"question_code":"EMERGENCY_FUND","option_code":"M3_6"},{"question_code":"LOSS_REACTION","option_code":"HOLD"},{"question_code":"EXPERIENCE","option_code":"FUNDS_LT_3Y"},{"question_code":"OBJECTIVE","option_code":"BALANCED"}]}; assert 201; then submit ANS_28
GET /api/v1/risk-profile; assert risk_band 'AGGRESSIVE', source 'ASSESSMENT', source_id == second assessment_id
GET /api/v1/risk-profile/history; assert 2 items newest first, type 'ASSESSMENT', bands AGGRESSIVE then MODERATE, policy_version_no 1

description: Customers see only their own risk profile
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true

GET /api/v1/risk-profile/questionnaire (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice); POST /api/v1/risk-profile/assessments (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-alice) body {"policy_version_id": <questionnaire.policy_version_id>, "answers": [{"question_code":"AGE","option_code":"AGE_30_39"},{"question_code":"HORIZON","option_code":"Y7_10"},{"question_code":"INCOME_STABILITY","option_code":"STABLE_SINGLE"},{"question_code":"EMERGENCY_FUND","option_code":"M3_6"},{"question_code":"LOSS_REACTION","option_code":"HOLD"},{"question_code":"EXPERIENCE","option_code":"FUNDS_LT_3Y"},{"question_code":"OBJECTIVE","option_code":"BALANCED"}]}; assert 201
GET /api/v1/risk-profile (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-bob); assert risk_band null
GET /api/v1/risk-profile/history (header Authorization: Bearer stub-token-bob); assert []

description: Submitting with a stale policy_version_id returns 409 POLICY_VERSION_STALE and writes nothing
steps: Run poetry run pytest ../tests/acceptance/test_ac_risk_profile.py -k stale (fixture inserts a PUBLISHED v2 risk policy via the repository)
POST /api/v1/risk-profile/assessments with v1 policy_version_id and ANS_16; assert 409 error.code POLICY_VERSION_STALE
Assert risk_assessments count unchanged

description: Logs from the risk-profile flow contain IDs only, never usernames, option codes, bands or scores
steps: Run poetry run pytest ../tests/architecture/test_no_pii_in_logs.py
Assert captured log lines include assessment_id and customer_id
Assert no log line contains 'alice.customer', 'AGE_30_39', 'MODERATE' or the score value as a customer-bound field

description: MODERATE customer with no goals gets the v1 MODERATE template with NO_GOAL
steps: Fresh DB: cd backend && poetry run alembic upgrade head; start app with WEALTHWISE_STUB_AUTH_ENABLED=true
